sourceReview.reason: Original November 13 24-hour Token Terminal/RWA Foundation dataset for the claimed $44.9m versus $29m/$10.8m increases was not independently accessible as full primary evidence. Publisher full text and Token Terminal November 12 newsletter were read, but the newsletter reports a different measurement window. Hold pending a verifiable original daily dataset or sufficiently independent full-text corroboration; retry no sooner than six hours.
